## Blog Posts

- [Neuralink VOICE Trial: ALS Patient Speaks Again with Brain Implant](https://anidsiam.github.io/blogs/neuralink-update/): Neuralink's VOICE clinical trial helps ALS patient Kenneth Shock turn thoughts into spoken words using the N1 brain implant.
- [Brain Computer Interface (BCI): Complete Guide 2026](https://anidsiam.github.io/blogs/brain-computer-interface-complete-guide-2026/): Complete guide to BCI technology — how Neuralink, Synchron, and others are connecting brains to computers.
- [Quantum Computer Price in 2026](https://anidsiam.github.io/blogs/quantum-computer-price-cost-guide-2026/): How much quantum computers cost, from $5,000 educational systems to $100 million enterprise machines.
- [Why You Should Become an Indie Hacker in 2026](https://anidsiam.github.io/blogs/why-become-indie-hacker-2026/): Build your own SaaS and escape the 9-to-5 as a solo entrepreneur.
- [Build a Website for Only $10.88 a Year](https://anidsiam.github.io/blogs/website-cost-10-dollars-year-free-hosting/): Free static site hosting with custom domain using Hugo, Netlify, and GitHub Pages.
- [Easiest Programming Language for Beginners in 2026](https://anidsiam.github.io/blogs/programming-for-beginners-2026/): Honest advice on choosing your first programming language and avoiding common beginner mistakes.
- [Gold Technical Analysis: Nine Candle Pattern](https://anidsiam.github.io/blogs/gold-nine-candle-analysis/): A different kind of technical analysis about Gold, adjusted with Gareth Soloway's weekly chart methodology.
